categories.main_business_segments: Cubic Digital Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: intelligent software and hardware business, which includes digital cloud infrastructure products such as smart hardware, software, and platforms; and digital intelligent services, offering BIM, CIM digital delivery, customized digital intelligent platforms, and technical services. The company also engages in sales and installation of building materials and has a proprietary server business under its subsidiary Shenzhen Supercube Data Technology Co., Ltd.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud computing, AI, BIM (Building Information Modeling), CIM (City Information Modeling), and IoT technologies to develop integrated software and hardware solutions. It emphasizes proprietary R&D with 169 software copyrights and 40 patents, focusing on digital cloud infrastructure, intelligent platform customization, and digital project lifecycle management. Manufacturing includes in-house server design and production, enhancing cost structure and market competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include enterprises in construction, manufacturing, automotive parts, logistics, and government sectors requiring digital transformation and intelligent upgrades. Major projects include landmark infrastructure such as the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, Guangzhou Baiyun Airport, and Shanghai Disney. The company serves both domestic and international clients, with significant export revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide across China with a focus on strategic regions including the Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. It also has overseas operations through subsidiaries, notably in Hong Kong. Revenue is generated from multiple regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, Southwest, and exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cubic Digital Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital infrastructure supply chain, providing integrated digital solutions, software, hardware products, and cloud services to end customers. It also engages in upstream manufacturing of proprietary servers, enhancing vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in digital infrastructure, cloud computing, AI, and intelligent platform development. It invests in R&D to enhance product innovation, expand application scenarios, and improve cost efficiency. Strategic initiatives include strengthening proprietary server development, expanding digital intelligent services, and fostering industry collaborations to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of intelligent hardware and software, digital intelligent service contracts including BIM and CIM services, customized platform development, and cloud service subscriptions. The company also earns from technical consulting and project-based digital delivery services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading digital technology cloud service provider specializing in new digital infrastructure with strong R&D capabilities and comprehensive digital transformation solutions. It competes in the software and information technology services industry, focusing on construction and industrial digitalization sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 258.5 million, a 37.45% increase from 2023, but continued to incur net losses of about RMB 125 million. Cash flow from operations improved significantly to RMB 53.3 million. The company is in a growth and adjustment phase, expanding its business scale and improving profitability gradually.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cubic Digital Technology offers integrated digital transformation solutions combining proprietary software, hardware, and cloud platforms tailored to industry-specific needs. Its differentiation lies in deep industry expertise, strong R&D with numerous patents and copyrights, and the ability to provide full lifecycle digital project management. The company emphasizes cost-effective, high-quality, and innovative digital infrastructure enabling clients to achieve efficient, intelligent upgrades and operational excellence.
